As illustrated in Figure 7, the baseline system operates the chiller continuously to meet building loads, including during peak hours. By contrast, RBC shifts operation by charging TES during off-peak hours (00:00–08:00 and 08:00–14:00) and discharging during the on-peak period (14:00–19:00). MPC further improves this strategy by dynamically scheduling charging and discharging according to both forecast load and price signals, resulting in smoother operation and greater use of TES during high-cost periods.
